anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as expected.
No active trades or profit/loss activity, which may indicate a lack of market engagement or strategy execution issues.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially update AI models or algorithms to ensure they are functioning and generating opportunities as expected.
Consider increasing memory allocation if CPU optimizations do not resolve performance issues, as free memory is available.

recommendations.action: Immediately investigate the cause of high CPU load and address any bottlenecks or inefficient processes.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough review of the AI system to identify why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: The AI system's inactivity suggests a malfunction or misconfiguration, which could hinder trading strategy effectiveness.

recommendations.action: Evaluate the trading strategies and market conditions to understand why there are no active trades or profit/loss activity.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring strategies are aligned with current market conditions is essential for maintaining trading activity and profitability.
